scope: G3 legacy-vs-decomposed parity on push to main
expected: Legacy G3 produces an exact-head check result for every release/main SHA consumed by the G3 aggregator.
actual: The main-push G3 aggregator waited for a check named 'G3 Artifact Integrity Shadow' on the exact main SHA, but the legacy shadow workflow only declared pull_request and workflow_dispatch triggers, so no exact-head legacy check could be produced by the push pipeline.

changes: Add push trigger for main while preserving the exact-head checkout and evidence identity contract.
Bound the G3 browser step with an explicit 8-minute step timeout and 420-second shell timeout after an observed in-progress runner state exceeded the 25-minute job budget.

secondaryExecutionFinding.evidence: Steps 1-9 completed successfully; browser step remained in_progress; workflow run remained in_progress beyond its declared 25-minute job timeout; GitHub rejected a targeted rerun because the run was still marked running.
secondaryExecutionFinding.recovery: Invalidate the stale run as release evidence, close/reopen PR to clear its queued successor, and push a fresh SHA with explicit step/process time bounds.

verificationRequired: legacy G3 exact-head check on fresh SHA
G3 aggregator success on fresh SHA
CI-11 exit gate PASS with fresh evidence
